demo.title: W9-W10 end-to-end demo: e-commerce refund automation
demo.description: Pick a refund case and run it in one click: AI decides whether to refund automatically or escalate to a human based on the refund reason and approval limits, while the canvas shows node progress in real time. You can also generate a refund flow draft from natural language.

cards.graph: The refund flow is compiled from DSL to LangGraph and run; node events stream to the UI over SSE
cards.loop: Minimal OODA loop is up and running
cards.harness: Contract/registry layer plus the Playwright web adapter (three-layer targeting) are up and running
